name: Bai Choi
description: Bai Choi is a traditional Vietnamese card-and-performance game family using dedicated Bai Choi cards and call-response play.

content.text: Bai Choi is a traditional Vietnamese card-and-performance game family using dedicated Bai Choi cards and call-response play.
Originates from 18th-century Japan. Hanafuda cards were developed as a way to circumvent government bans on Western-style gambling cards, using floral imagery instead of numbers.
Multiple players; exact table format varies by local Bai Choi performance style.
48 cards. Suits by month: January (Pine), February (Plum), March (Cherry)... to December (Paulownia). Each suit has 4 cards of varying value (Bright, Animal, Ribbon, Chaff).
48 cards. Suits by month: January (Pine), February (Plum), March (Cherry)... to December (Paulownia). Each suit has 4 cards of varying value (Bright, Animal, Ribbon, Chaff).
Each player is dealt 8 cards face-down; 8 cards are placed face-up in the 'field' (ba). The rest form the draw pile.

items.text: 6 rounds: Play 6 hands instead of 12; players may agree before the game.
Koi-Koi once per hand: Player may call Koi-Koi only once per hand (not on every yaku-forming turn).
Tsukimi-zake and Hanami-zake optional: Some rulesets omit the Moon Viewing and Flower Viewing yaku.
